sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Lucy is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II.

sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: The second android made by Reeze, a scientist from Bectas who got into the field of technology thanks to her brother's influence. The first android she made specialized in close combat, so she decided to make this one a ranged attacker, allowing her to use her gun to attack enemies from afar. Compared to her predecessor, she has functions that allow her to prioritize actions based on any orders she receives from humans, as well as the capacity to learn. Lilith, her younger sibling who was to be built later, is said to have inherited and perfected a lot of Lucy’s original functions.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content: - Lucy is the second humanoid weapon developed by Reeze
